name: World-writable file/dir permissions in os package
attack_scenario: A log or config file created 0666 is rewritten by another tenant on the host to inject a malicious payload; a 0777 upload directory lets a co-located process drop a script the app later executes.
negative_test_hint: as a different local user write "owned by attacker" into the created file and assert the write is denied because the mode grants no group/other write

exemplar.explanation: A trailing permission digit of 2, 3, 6 or 7 grants write to group/other (0666, 0777, 0776...), so any local user or a co-located compromised process can overwrite the file or plant executables in the directory. Use 0600 for private files, 0644 for read-shared files, 0700/0755 for directories.
